verdict.rationale: The pack contains no first-party documentation on database performance at scale or on item and row caps for workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks. Community posts mention general client sluggishness and a past 1000-block limit, but none of this is vendor-documented guidance on scale behavior, so the applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an engineer, I know how the product performs and whether item caps apply in workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks
